set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: O04.3
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend engineer with institutional data steward
Scope: Qualify withdrawal and interrupted recovery against the declared local engineering lifecycle profile; institutional erasure/retention acceptance remains O04.2.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O04 (bd-01M4W40KFJVWZAM6RZ8DDH4P2D)
Suggested delivery tranche: T3; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Back up, withdraw data and alter a shared/derived disclosure decision, then isolate/destroy the disposable source namespace; the restored service preserves all current restrictions without consulting original state.
2. Interrupted journal replay or integrity verification cannot partially open access; audit and task/report surfaces do not reveal withdrawn content.
3. Demonstrate the engineering profile’s dispositions for missing/deleted fixture bytes, held/shared retained content and unsupported-erasure admission; report unavailable historical data truthfully and do not claim qualified physical erasure.

Verification: Adversarial disaster/withdrawal report with exact access assertions, missing-byte cases and accepted lifecycle decisions.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O04.3/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- docs/prd.md
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresRecovery.scala
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- H03.2: bd-01M4X8MAJJN8C3ZKDHM164G25X
- O03.5: bd-01M4W5P9RBT3Z991BA5S2B0DH7

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: O04.3: Prove withdrawal survives backup replay and interrupted recovery
